items.requirement: A signal the coprocessor reads that tells the DC input from the pack: a DC-input-present input or the DC input voltage, on an RP2354B input or an expander pin within the pin budget. Answered under Raised by P1: V271: One signal: the DC input voltage through a divider into one ADC input of the measurement coprocessor, GPIO 40 to 47. The firmware compares it with the thresholds, so it serves the source status and the DC input brownout detection (owner, 2026-10-01) V276: As V271: the DC input voltage on one ADC input of the measurement coprocessor, serving both (owner, 2026-10-01)

items.requirement: Detects the DC input falling below a threshold, which the coprocessor reads; non-destructive (owner, 2026-09-30). Its threshold and the time below it are not stated. The source selection's undervoltage gate is 10.1 V falling and 11.0 V rising (V88). Answered under Raised by P1: V272: Trips at 11.0 V falling and resets at 11.5 V rising, above the source selection's 10.1 V handover (V88) (owner, 2026-10-01) V273: 10 ms (owner, 2026-10-01) V274: As V272: 11.0 V falling, 11.5 V rising (owner, 2026-10-01) V275: As V273: 10 ms (owner, 2026-10-01)

value.quantity: pack full-charge voltage used for sizing (V, upper bound)
value.refutation_tried: checked the SLS XTRON vendor-page description at IOBoard.md:395 -- it states 7.4 V nominal and no per-cell charge limit, so 4.2 V/cell is not vendor-confirmed; already raised as V92 ('for research'), not re-raised

value.quantity: board draw from the pack at the 6.0 V floor, nominal (A)
value.refutation_tried: recomputed the four-converter subtotal from the page's own per-converter figures: 3 servo converters at 9.9 A each (IOBoard.md:359) = 29.7 A, plus the adjustable supply at 17.6 A (IOBoard.md:381) = 47.3 A, matching the stated four-converter figure exactly; adding the display's 1.4 A (IOBoard.md:395) and the second RP2354B's 0.2 A (IOBoard.md:120) gives 48.9 A, about 0.8 A short of the stated 49.7 A, with the remainder (the main RP2354B's and other unitemized logic current) not broken out anywhere in the tree; the underlying 90% pack-side efficiency is explicitly 'not stated' and remains open at V90/V105/V111 ('for research')

value.quantity: stated failure reasons of the pack disconnect candidates
value.value: each candidate failed an open balance lead (V107), the reconnect condition (V93, V94) or the per-cell floor (V95)
value.refutation_tried: read every P2, P3, rerank and P4 return for R5's pack disconnect across T3, FU-B1 and FU-B3 -- only one candidate was ever shortlisted, R5460N212AF-TR-FE, refuted in both FU-B1 (hardware/research/round1/FU-B1/032-P4-datasheet-R5.json) and FU-B3 specifically on the balance-lead-open check (V107); the same P4 return shows it passing the reconnect-condition (V93, V94) and per-cell-floor (V95) checks. No candidate's recorded failure is the reconnect condition or the per-cell floor; the claim is not supported by the primary files read for this task

value.quantity: nominal board draw from the pack at the 6.0 V floor
value.value: about 49.7 A with the display, the logic rails and the second RP2354B included; about 47.3 A from the four TPS55285 converters alone at an assumed 90 % efficiency
value.source: IOBoard.md:359 (Pack path current): 'at the 6.0 V floor the four converters at 6.35 A draw about 47.3 A at an assumed 90 %, and the board about 49.7 A ... nominal figures'.
value.refutation_tried: The page itself calls these 'nominal figures' with 'no upper bound' until the protection threshold is set (IOBoard.md:395). The 90 % efficiency from the pack is unverified (already raised as V140, Research.md:836, 'for research'); not re-raised here. Holds as the nominal, not maximum, draw this follow-up's threshold has to clear.

value.quantity: charger efficiency and resulting charge current
value.value: assumed 90 %: 13.5 W, about 1.6 A into a full pack at 8.4 V; a 2 A charger (BQ25887 reference figure) uses the whole 13.5 W above 6.75 V
value.source: IOBoard.md:400 (Charge current): 'At an assumed 90 % that is 13.5 W ...'.
value.refutation_tried: No source is given for 90 %; the same unverified figure as V139 (Research.md:835, 'for research'), already under Raised by P1 and not re-raised. The arithmetic (15 W x 0.9 = 13.5 W; 13.5 W / 8.4 V = 1.607 A) holds.
